tools.name: pinecone_explain_strategies
tools.description:
🎓 COMPREHENSIVE VECTOR DATABASE EDUCATION TOOL

This tool provides expert explanations, definitions, use cases, and strategic guidance for Pinecone vector database configurations. Use this when users need help understanding:

📚 CORE CONCEPTS:
- Vector embeddings and semantic search fundamentals
- Dense vs sparse vectors (hybrid search)
- Similarity metrics (cosine, euclidean, dotproduct)
- Namespaces and multi-tenancy architecture
- Metadata filtering and query optimization

🎯 STRATEGIC DECISIONS:
- When to use hybrid search vs pure semantic search
- How to structure namespaces for different use cases
- Optimal chunk sizes for document processing
- Category/folder organization strategies
- User permission models (user/global/team visibility)

⚙️ CONFIGURATION GUIDANCE:
- Index dimension selection (384, 768, 1536, 3072)
- Metric selection based on embedding model
- top_k parameter tuning for accuracy vs performance
- Chunk size and overlap optimization
- Sparse vector feature count selection

💡 USE CASE EXAMPLES:
- Legal document management with compliance
- Customer support knowledge base
- E-commerce product search
- Healthcare patient records (HIPAA-compliant)
- Multi-tenant SaaS applications
- Enterprise document repositories

🔬 ADVANCED PATTERNS:
- Hybrid search implementation (dense + sparse)
- Cross-namespace aggregation
- Metadata filtering operators ($eq, $ne, $gt, $in)
- Reranking strategies for improved relevance
- Multi-modal embeddings (text + images)

EXAMPLE QUERIES:
- 'Explain when to use cosine vs euclidean distance'
- 'How should I structure namespaces for a legal firm?'
- 'What chunk size is best for technical documentation?'
- 'Explain hybrid search and when to use it'
- 'How do I implement user permissions with Pinecone?'
- 'What are metadata filters and how do I use them?'
